description: This source file defines the class `Image_Graph_Plotarea` which is part of the PEAR `Image_Graph` package. The class manages the rendering and configuration of a plot area within a graph, including axes management, coordinate calculations, element addition, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
classes.description: A class responsible for representing and rendering a plot area with axes in a graph.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the plot area with optional axes and direction.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object in the object hierarchy.

methods.name: setPlotBorderStyle
methods.description: Sets the style of the plot border line style.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the plot area, associating it with an axis.

methods.name: _plotWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the actual plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _plotHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the actual plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _setExtrema
methods.description: Sets the minimum and maximum values for the axes based on the data in a plot.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _axisPointX
methods.description: Converts a data value to a pixel position along the X axis.

methods.name: _axisPointY
methods.description: Converts a data value to a pixel position along the Y axis.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Returns the pixel position offset for a value on the X axis.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Returns the pixel position offset for a value on the Y axis.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Returns the distance between axis labels for a given axis.

methods.name: hideAxis
methods.description: Hides the specified axis or all axes if no parameter is given.

methods.name: clearAxis
methods.description: Removes all axes from the plot area.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis object associated with the specified axis type.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the coordinates of axes and plot area elements.

methods.name: setAxisPadding
methods.description: Configures padding around axes within the plot area.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the plot area onto the canvas, including axes and background.
